_: A vendor's REST API, read with a key (apireads.py): each row is the base (or the card's own address for a self-hosted one), how the key rides (bearer / header+format / query / basic, or google / graph: the app's own sign-ins), the cheap GET the card's Test makes, and the vendor's page it was read off (2026-11-08). The Connections page reads the same rows.

digitalocean.title: DigitalOcean
digitalocean.desc: Droplets, apps, databases, domains and billing as reports and an agent tool - GET /v2/droplets, /v2/apps, /v2/customers/my/balance.

terraform_cloud.title: Terraform Cloud
terraform_cloud.desc: Workspaces, runs and their state as reports and an agent tool - GET /organizations/<org>/workspaces, /workspaces/<id>/runs.

better_stack.title: Better Stack
better_stack.desc: Uptime monitors, incidents and on-call as reports and an agent tool - GET /monitors, /incidents.

circleci.title: CircleCI
circleci.key_page: app.circleci.com → User settings → Personal API Tokens
circleci.desc: Pipelines, workflows and failed jobs as reports and an agent tool - GET /project/<slug>/pipeline, /workflow/<id>/job.

buildkite.title: Buildkite
buildkite.key_page: buildkite.com → Personal settings → API access tokens
buildkite.desc: Builds, pipelines and agents as reports and an agent tool - GET /organizations/<org>/builds?state=failed.

coda.title: Coda
coda.key_page: coda.io → Account settings → API settings → Generate API token
coda.desc: Docs, tables and rows as reports and an agent tool - GET /docs, /docs/<id>/tables/<table>/rows.

intrinio.title: Intrinio
intrinio.desc: Company data, fundamentals and prices as reports and an agent tool - GET /companies/<ticker>, /securities/<ticker>/prices.

benzinga.title: Benzinga
benzinga.desc: Market news and calendars as reports and an agent tool - GET /news?tickers=AAPL, /calendar/earnings.

tradier.title: Tradier
tradier.desc: Quotes, option chains, balances and positions as reports and an agent tool - read only: no order is ever placed from this card.

diffbot.title: Diffbot
diffbot.desc: A web page read into clean article text and fields - GET /v3/article?url=<page>, /v3/analyze?url=<page>.

jenkins.title: Jenkins
jenkins.key_page: Jenkins → your name → Configure → API Token
jenkins.desc: Jobs, builds and their console as reports and an agent tool - GET /api/json, /job/<name>/lastBuild/api/json.

sonarqube.title: SonarQube
sonarqube.key_page: SonarQube → My Account → Security → Generate token
sonarqube.desc: Quality gates, issues and coverage as reports and an agent tool - GET /api/qualitygates/project_status?projectKey=<key>.

elastic.title: Elasticsearch
elastic.desc: Indices, cluster health and search results as reports and an agent tool - GET /_cat/indices?format=json, /<index>/_search?q=...

splunk.title: Splunk
splunk.desc: Saved searches, their results and server health as reports and an agent tool, over the management port (8089).

dynatrace.title: Dynatrace
dynatrace.key_page: Dynatrace → Access tokens → Generate new token
dynatrace.desc: Problems, entities and metrics as reports and an agent tool - GET /api/v2/problems, /api/v2/metrics/query?metricSelector=...

kubernetes.title: Kubernetes
kubernetes.desc: Namespaces, pods, deployments and events as reports and an agent tool - GET /api/v1/namespaces/<ns>/pods. Reads only.

google_drive.title: Google Drive
google_drive.desc: Find and list files in your Google Drive with the Google Sheets card's sign-in - GET /files?q=name contains 'budget'. Nothing to paste here.

onedrive.title: OneDrive
onedrive.desc: Find and list files in your OneDrive with the Outlook card's Microsoft sign-in - GET /me/drive/root/children, /me/drive/root/search(q='budget').

office365_files.title: Microsoft 365 files
office365_files.desc: Files shared with you across OneDrive and SharePoint, with the Outlook card's Microsoft sign-in - GET /me/drive/sharedWithMe, /sites?search=...
